---
name: Feature request
about: Describe an MCP workload or integration that the current interface cannot serve.
---

## Use case

Describe the concrete workload, revision, current API and expected outcome.
Explain the limitation and any workaround.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the API or wire contract, ownership, cancellation and failure behavior.
For protocol additions, link the relevant official specification and distinguish
standard behavior from an application extension.

## Validation

Give a small example and observable acceptance criteria. Identify platform,
SDK interoperability and installed-consumer checks that would be needed.
